Keep all aliases and local restrictions: 充二分 is search-only; 充分 has an ateji flag, and division-into-ten is restricted to 十分; 不充分 is a separate negative word. Existing 十分 article is not a written 充 support and does not activate a metadata link merely through its alias mention.

Preserve separate fullness verbs, their rare/search-only aliases and sense scopes. Do not add みちる or みつ to the frozen 充 metadata or relabel them nanori; they are simply outside this card's frozen reading list and selected teaching.

Preserve local spelling flags rather than distributing them across a whole family: 充塡 is rare in the filling family, 充電機 and 充塡豆腐 are search-only in their own families. Neither alias is needed for practical selected keys.

Recognized substantiality/improvement, electrical/figurative charging, allocation and replenishment provide additional on examples, but 拡充 already supplies the selected on key. No extra articles are necessary merely to broaden this kanji batch; keep colloquial and sense-local distinctions raw.
Keep slang/Internet-slang labels and abbreviation explanations local to their actual entries. These are not a name-reading course, etymological evidence for 充, or necessary support additions.

Remaining complete inspected families are retained as source evidence, with all technical/domain, idiom, POS, aliases and local notes intact. No additional support is necessary for the two proposed practical keys. Nonselection is not a claim that these words/readings are rare, invalid, interchangeable or personal names.

comparisonDispositions.decision: Full overlapping families already inspected in the lexical packet; preserve eight overlaps as occurrences rather than eight extra distinct families. Spelling, transitivity, alternate meanings and restrictions remain local.

割り当てる is verified allocation but has no existing article; no broken link or unnecessary article. Existing 当てる shares あてる and an allotting sense but its primary teaching is physical contact/guessing. Propose a direct guard with 充てる and a qualified comparison, not an absolute prohibition of all semantic overlap.

Packing, supplementation and the two separate 埋める readings do not establish 充てる's allocation meaning or a universal filling synonym class. No direct guards for their current labels are proposed with the narrow allocate/earmark title.
十分じゅっぷん/じっぷん ten minutes is distinct from じゅうぶん. Do not use a same-written-form timer family or alternative 充分 spelling to assign a false reading/metadata pair.

quizDispositions.decision: 指定 assignment/designation, 振る work allocation, 配る personnel allocation and 注ぐ figurative devotion can overlap the proposed allocation/earmark label or 充てる's resource-for-purpose sense. Propose direct guards with these actual existing identities; no transitive clique and no unrestricted grammar substitution.

Actual reserve/spare, booking, stock-building and saving-for-later families and articles inspected. Do not define 充てる simply as keeping an unused reserve, and do not infer direct exclusions merely from shared English set aside. The chosen allocate/earmark title avoids that broad translation trap.

Complete same-spelling alternatives are preserved: 振るぶる is an ordinarily kana-written suffix/pretending verb, 注ぐつぐ is kana-usual vessel pouring. They are not the current articles' primary readings or the senses motivating allocation guards.
